text: All right. Good afternoon. I call to order this June 29th, 2026 Select Committee for Hearing Appeals. Do we have a motion? Yes, Mr. Chair, we do. Thanks, Mr. Pepper. Would you please read the motion? Yes. I move that the Loudoun County School Board recess this public meeting and enter into a closed meeting pursuant to Section 2.2-3712 of the Code of Virginia for the following purposes: discussion or consideration of matters that would

involve the disclosure of information contained in a scholastic record concerning a student, namely the parent's request for an appeal of a student walk zone, which is authorized by Section 2.2-3711.A2 of the Code of Virginia. Discussion or consideration of matters that would involve the disclosure of information contained in a scholastic record concerning a student, namely a parent request for an LCPS student to be granted a waiver of the Virginia High School League, VHSL, transfer rule

28A-7-1, which is authorized by Section 2.2-3711.A2 of the Code of Virginia. Discussion or consideration of matters that would involve the disclosure of information contained in a scholastic record concerning a student, namely parent request for an LCPS student to attend a school outside of their assigned attendance zone, which is authorized by Section 2.2-3711.A2 of the Code of Virginia. Thank you, Mr. Pepper. Do we have a second?

I second. I second the motion. With a second from Ms. Bell, the motion has been made and properly seconded. All in favor of the motion, please say aye. Aye. Aye. Aye. The motion passes with all three board members present voting yes. And with that, we have convened the closed meeting. We are now returning from our closed session. Mr. Pepper, do you have a motion?

I do, Mr. Chair. Please go ahead. I move that the closed meeting be adjourned, that the Loudoun County School Board reconvene its public meeting, and that the minutes of the public meeting reflect that no formal action was taken in the closed meeting. Do we have a second? I second. The motion's been made and properly seconded. All in favor say aye. Aye. Aye. Aye. The motion passes three to zero, with all school board members present. Mr. Pepper, do you have an additional motion? I do, Mr. Chair. Please go ahead.

I move that the following resolution certifying the closed meeting be adopted and reflected in the minutes of the public meeting. Resolution number 52-25/26, whereas the Loudoun County School Board has convened a closed meeting on this date pursuant to an affirmative recorded vote and in accordance with the provisions of the Virginia Freedom of Information Act. And whereas Section 2.2-3712 section D of the Code of Virginia requires a certification by the school board that such closed meeting was conducted in conformity with Virginia law. Now, therefore, be it resolved, the Loudoun County

School Board hereby certifies that, to the best of each member's knowledge, one, only public business matters lawfully exempted from open meeting requirements by Virginia law were discussed in the closed meeting to which the certification applies. And two, only such public business matters as were identified in the motion convening the closed meeting were heard, discussed, or considered by the Loudoun County School Board. Do we have a second for that motion? I second. The motion's been made and properly seconded. All in favor say aye. Aye. Aye.

The motion passes three to zero, with all school board members present. Mr. Pepper, do you have an additional motion? I do, Mr. Chair. Please go ahead. I move that the Select Committee of the school board's findings and decisions included in the attached table be adopted and reflected in the minutes of this public meeting. The motion's been made. Do we have a second? Second. The motion's been made and properly seconded. All school board members in favor say aye. Aye. Aye. The motion passes three to zero, with all school board members present.
At this time, we will convene this meeting, this June 29th, 2026, special permission appeals meeting, and adjourn it. Thank you.
